# sharepoint-permission-trim API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/documentation.cjs. Do not edit. -->

Advisory content branches selected by effective SharePoint resource permissions.

## PermissionTrim

Mounts protected children only when current effective permissions match. Uses
useSPFxCrossSitePermissions for the selected resource; a current native web
mask avoids HTTP. Denials, loading and validation/transport errors select the
respective structural branch. Identity changes hide previous grants during
render. This is advisory presentation: server operations still enforce access.

Source-owned support type; no public named import.

### Throws

- Missing matching SPFx provider.

### Examples

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { SharePointPermissionTrim } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { SPPermission } from '@microsoft/sp-page-context';
<SharePointPermissionTrim permissions={[SPPermission.addListItems]} scope="list" listTitle="Tasks">
  <button>Create task</button>
  <SharePointPermissionTrim.Loading>Checking</SharePointPermissionTrim.Loading>
  <SharePointPermissionTrim.Fallback>Read only</SharePointPermissionTrim.Fallback>
  <SharePointPermissionTrim.ErrorFallback>Check unavailable</SharePointPermissionTrim.ErrorFallback>
</SharePointPermissionTrim>
```

### Signatures

```ts
(props: SharePointPermissionTrimProps): ReactElement<any, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>>
```

#### Parameters

- `props`: Scoped target, nonempty permissions, match and structural children.

#### Returns

Active content in a React fragment, without a DOM wrapper.

## SharePointPermissionTrim

Headless current-user effective permission trim beneath a matching SPFx provider.
Uses the scoped permissions hook: web is default, list/item/folder require their
selectors, all is default and any accepts one requested native mask. Only the
current positive decision mounts protected children. Loading/denial/error select
their unique direct family branches; omitted active content is empty. No DOM
wrapper, styling or callbacks. Server authorization remains required.

### Imports

```ts
import { SharePointPermissionTrim } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { SharePointPermissionTrim } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import { SharePointPermissionTrim } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/sharepoint-permission-trim';
```

### Use when

- Effective current-user SharePoint permission masks should select resource-specific content branches.

### Avoid when

- Keep server authorization on every protected operation; the trim only controls rendering.

### Throws (2)

- Missing matching SPFx provider.

### Examples (2)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { SharePointPermissionTrim } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { SPPermission } from '@microsoft/sp-page-context';
<SharePointPermissionTrim permissions={[SPPermission.addListItems]}>
  <button>Create</button>
  <SharePointPermissionTrim.Fallback>Read only</SharePointPermissionTrim.Fallback>
</SharePointPermissionTrim>
```

### Signatures (2)

(props: SharePointPermissionTrimProps): ReactElement<any, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>>

## SharePointPermissionTrimBranchProps

Structural permission-trim branch content; no wrapper, ref, formatting or DOM
props are added. Place each branch once directly beneath its own trim family.
Changing the active branch or its React marker key remounts its content; an
unchanged branch/key preserves consumer state and child keys.

### Imports (5)

```ts
import type { SharePointPermissionTrimBranchProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { SharePointPermissionTrimBranchProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { SharePointPermissionTrimBranchProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/sharepoint-permission-trim';
```

### Examples (10)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { SharePointPermissionTrim, SharePointPermissionTrimBranchProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { SPPermission } from '@microsoft/sp-page-context';
const branch: SharePointPermissionTrimBranchProps = { children: 'Checking permissions' };
<SharePointPermissionTrim permissions={[SPPermission.addListItems]}>
  <SharePointPermissionTrim.Loading {...branch} />;
</SharePointPermissionTrim>
```

### Members (5)

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SharePointPermissionTrimBranchProps.children` | `ReactNode` | Optional, readonly | — | Optional branch content, mounted only when this branch is active. When omitted, renders empty; ReactNode preserves legacy null input. |

## SharePointPermissionTrimProps

Headless permission check for one current-user SharePoint resource. Requires a
matching SPFx provider. Inherits scope/web/list/item/folder selectors and their
validation from SPFxScopedPermissionsOptions; omitted scope selects web.

### Imports (6)

```ts
import type { SharePointPermissionTrimProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { SharePointPermissionTrimProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { SharePointPermissionTrimProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/sharepoint-permission-trim';
```

### Examples (11)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { SharePointPermissionTrim, SharePointPermissionTrimProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { SPPermission } from '@microsoft/sp-page-context';
const props: SharePointPermissionTrimProps = {
  scope: 'list', listTitle: 'Tasks', permissions: [SPPermission.addListItems],
};
<SharePointPermissionTrim {...props}>Create task</SharePointPermissionTrim>;
```

### Type (4)

```ts
type SharePointPermissionTrimProps = SPFxScopedPermissionsOptions & {
  /**
   * Required nonempty native SPPermission constants or combined masks, with unsigned Int32 High/Low in their public value. Invalid/empty/sparse input selects ErrorFallback without a request; compatible peer instances are accepted by mask shape.
   */
  readonly permissions: readonly SPPermission[];
  /**
   * all (when omitted) requires every permission; any requires one. Invalid values select ErrorFallback.
   * @defaultValue 'all'
   */
  readonly match?: 'all' | 'any';
  /**
   * Protected content and unique direct Loading/Fallback/ErrorFallback branches. Only the active content mounts; when omitted, renders empty. ReactNode retains legacy React null interoperability.
   */
  readonly children?: ReactNode;
}
```
